summary: Frontend-only regression of the donation flow after DonationValuePage was removed. All 7 requested checks passed on the preview URL: home iframe preset R$98 + CONFIRMAR -> /doacao/dados (value R$98,00 carried over); Voltar (back-button) -> '/' with the home iframe rendered; /doacao/valor redirects to '/'; the dados page renders the AACD logo (loaded, naturalWidth 215), 'Finalizar Doação', red strip, 4 inputs and the Resumo card; CONTINUAR stays disabled until all 4 valid fields are filled, then goes to /doacao/pix; DOAR ANONIMAMENTE -> /doacao/pix. grep found no leftover DonationValuePage or /doacao/valor references except the Navigate redirect.

integration_issues.issue: PixPaymentPage.jsx line 62 navigates to '/doacao', which redirects to /instituicao/humus, not to Home '/'. This doesn't match the new flow, where line 379 'DOAR NOVAMENTE' goes to '/'. Not covered by the request, but probably should be '/'.

action_items: Optional: change PixPaymentPage.jsx line 62 navigate('/doacao') to navigate('/') so the flow is consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: PixPaymentPage donate-again-link still routes to the '/doacao' -> /instituicao/humus redirect instead of Home.
seed_data_creation: None. The CONTINUAR and anonymous flows reached /doacao/pix, which may have created PIX/donation records in the backend for 'Maria Silva' / anonymous at R$55.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home is an iframe (iframe[data-testid=home-aacd-frame]). Presets: .aacd-tab-layout-0-x-listItem button (55/98/160). The CONFIRMAR text button posts 'aacd-donate'. The /doacao/dados?value=55 query param works for direct access.
